task.description:
Write test specifications and unit tests for the API-05 history endpoint.

API-05 covers GET /instances/:id/history with optional filters (event_type, from, to) and cursor-based pagination (API-06). Events are returned from both events and events_archive tables via UNION ALL.

Implementation that needs tests:
1. Store.readHistory() — new method in src/event_store/store.zig
2. handleHistory() — new handler in src/api/routes/instances.zig
3. parseIso8601ToMicros() — new helper in instances.zig
4. Cursor encode/decode — base64url "H:" prefix pattern

Test specifications (write to tests/specs/API-05.md):
- TC-API-05-01: GET /instances/:id/history returns events in ascending sequence order (happy path)
- TC-API-05-02: Instance not found → HTTP 404
- TC-API-05-03: Instance exists but has no events → empty list, HTTP 200
- TC-API-05-04: Filter by event_type returns only matching events
- TC-API-05-05: Filter by from/to timestamps (inclusive bounds)
- TC-API-05-06: from > to → HTTP 422
- TC-API-05-07: Unknown event_type → HTTP 422
- TC-API-05-08: Cursor pagination — next_cursor present when more events
- TC-API-05-09: Last page has null next_cursor
- TC-API-05-10: Invalid cursor format → HTTP 422
- TC-API-05-11: Expired cursor (>24h) → HTTP 410
- TC-API-05-12: page_size validation (≤0 → 422, >200 → 422, default 50)
- TC-API-05-13: Archived events returned interleaved with live events in correct sequence
- TC-API-05-14: ISO 8601 timestamp parsing (UTC, timezone offsets)

Implementation (write to tests/unit/test_api05_history.zig):
- Unit tests for parseIso8601ToMicros() with various timestamp formats
- Unit tests for cursor encode/decode (base64url round-trip)
- Unit tests for HistoryParams validation (page_size bounds, from > to, event_type)
- DB-touching tests may use SkipZigTest if no live DB available, but prefer real tests

Acceptance criteria:
- tests/specs/API-05.md exists with all test cases
- tests/unit/test_api05_history.zig or equivalent test file exists
- zig build test exits 0
- All new tests compile and run (may SkipZigTest DB-touching ones if no live DB)
acceptance_criteria: tests/specs/API-05.md exists with complete test case specifications
Unit test file for API-05 history endpoint exists and compiles

result.summary: Test specifications and unit tests for API-05 history endpoint: 19 test cases in tests/specs/API-05.md, 22 unit tests in tests/unit/test_api05_history.zig covering all handler-level validation paths (invalid UUID, page_size bounds, timestamp parsing, cursor decode/validation, cursor expiry). Pre-existing Zig 0.16 compilation issues in instances.zig and store.zig were fixed as blockers.
